name: Muhammad Iqbal Lukman
headline: Data Engineer
summary: Data engineer focused on reliable pipelines, datamarts, monitoring systems, and analytics products across fintech and professional services.

experience.title: Data Engineer
experience.description: Maintaining lending and payment data pipelines across GCP and AWS with Airflow, Spark, and Hive. Built data-quality sensors, launched LLM-assisted root-cause summaries, and improved Lending pipeline performance by migrating workloads from Presto to Spark.

experience.title: Business Intelligence / Data Analyst
experience.description: Built regulatory compliance, user-experience, lending, funnel, and customer-service data products with BigQuery, Presto, dbt, Airflow, and Spark SQL. Delivered audit reports and Tableau or Power BI monitoring insights for compliance, product analytics, lending KPIs, and customer-service performance.

experience.title: Data Analytics Associate
experience.description: Delivered enhanced audit analytics and data infrastructure modernization across banking, insurance, travel, and oil and gas. Unified fragmented financial and transactional data, automated reporting flows, and built Power BI and Python/Django solutions for audit and business stakeholders.

experience.title: Engineering Intern
experience.description: Worked with the Automation Engineering team to connect custom manufacturing equipment to an IIoT and SCADA monitoring flow. Built OEE monitoring views and a web application that turned machine signals into near-real-time operational insight, with a foundation for extending the approach to additional factory lines.

experience.title: Technology Intern
experience.description: Supported a telecommunications analytics project by mapping raw data to promotion metrics, building curated datamarts, and delivering weekly Power BI dashboards with data-backed insight presentations. Developed a Python-based Flask and Django web solution that connected directly to a local database, streamlining the manual 2–3 hour export process and demonstrating a reusable path to customer-behavior visualization.
